newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares ease in technical correction.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares ease in technical correction.

text.p: Slovenian shares eased 0.28 percent on Friday to end out the week 2.4 percent lower.
"This is just a techinical correction. I expect shares will continue to grow gradually in the next two months," one trader said.
* The SBI index eased 3.61 points to 1,268.2.
* Turnover firmed to 461.6 million tolars from 329.4 million.
* 11 shares fell, five rose, one kept steady and seven were untraded.
